description: This PHP source file defines the Aws\Chime\ChimeClient class, which extends Aws\AwsClient. It provides methods (both synchronous and asynchronous) to interact with the Amazon Chime service API. The class primarily consists of method annotations indicating the available AWS SDK methods related to Amazon Chime functionalities, such as managing meetings, users, and voice connectors.

classes.name: ChimeClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Chime service, extending the Aws\AwsClient base class. It exposes various methods for managing Chime resources and operations.

methods.name: associatePhoneNumberWithUser
methods.description: Associates a phone number with a user in Amazon Chime.

methods.name: associatePhoneNumberWithUserAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a phone number with a user in Amazon Chime.

methods.name: createMeeting
methods.description: Creates a new Amazon Chime meeting.

methods.name: createMeetingAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Amazon Chime meeting.

methods.name: deleteAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an Amazon Chime account.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specified Amazon Chime user.

methods.name: getUserAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a specified Amazon Chime user.
